request.style: English, male gravelly solo voice, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, mournful but steady, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A thorn was given to my flesh
A messenger sent to torment me
I pleaded three times with the Lord
To take this heavy burden away

[Chorus]
But he said to me
My grace is enough for you
For my power is brought to its fullness
In weakness

[Verse]
I am content with hardships now
With insults and persecution
I boast all the more gladly
About my weaknesses and pain

[Chorus]
But he said to me
My grace is enough for you
For my power is brought to its fullness
In weakness

[Bridge]
So the power of Christ
May rest upon my life
When I am weak then I am strong
In the middle of the night

[Chorus]
But he said to me
My grace is enough for you
For my power is brought to its fullness
In weakness

[Outro]
My grace is enough for you
My power is full in weakness
